## **1. Load Required Libraries**
```{r setup-libraries, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(multcompView)
library(multcomp)
library(colorspace)
library(performance)
library(patchwork)
library(PLS205)
library(forcats)
```


## **2. Load and Prepare Data**
```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
colonization_data <- read.csv("colonization_data.csv") %>%
mutate(
plant_id = factor(plant_id),
burn = factor(burn, levels = c("h", "ln", "lo", "n")),
drought = factor(drought),
sterilization = factor(sterilization),
rack = factor(rack)
)
str(colonization_data)
```



## **2. Filter for Unsterilized Samples and Test/Fit Final Model**
```{r fit-final-model}
# Filter to unsterilized samples only and re-do levels
colonization_filtered <- colonization_data %>%
  filter(sterilization == "u") %>%
  mutate(
    burn = fct_recode(burn,
      "High"          = "h",
      "Low (Initial)" = "ln",
      "Low (Advanced)"= "lo",
      "Suppressed"    = "n"
    ),
    # Set desired factor order (reference level = "High")
    burn = fct_relevel(burn, "High", "Low (Initial)", "Low (Advanced)", "Suppressed")
  )

# Apply arcsine sqrt transformation
colonization_transformed <- colonization_filtered %>%
  mutate(perc_col_asin = asin(sqrt(perc_col)))

```


```{r transformed model, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE, include=FALSE}

# Final full model for diagnostics (after filtering to unsterilized samples)
col_model_trans <- lm(perc_col_asin ~ burn * drought, data = colonization_transformed)

```

```{r}
# Compare full, additive, and burn-only models

# Full model
col_model_full <- lm(
  perc_col_asin ~ burn * drought,
  data = colonization_transformed
)

# Remove interaction
col_model_additive <- lm(
  perc_col_asin ~ burn + drought,
  data = colonization_transformed
)

# Remove drought
col_model_burn <- lm(
  perc_col_asin ~ burn,
  data = colonization_transformed
)

# Nested model comparisons
anova(
  col_model_burn,
  col_model_additive,
  col_model_full
)

# Compare AIC
AIC(
  col_model_burn,
  col_model_additive,
  col_model_full
)
```

## **3. Evaluate Rack as Random Effect**
```{r}
# Test again as a random effect using the final model structure

col_model_rack_final <- lmer(
  perc_col_asin ~ burn + (1 | rack),
  data = colonization_transformed,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Fixed-effects version using ML for comparison
col_model_fixed_final <- lm(
  perc_col_asin ~ burn,
  data = colonization_transformed
)

# Check rack variance
VarCorr(col_model_rack_final)

# Check for singular fit
isSingular(col_model_rack_final)

# Compare AIC
AIC(
  col_model_fixed_final,
  col_model_rack_final
)
```


## **4. ANOVA and Estimated Marginal Means**
```{r anova-emmeans}
# Final model after model comparison
# Neither drought nor burn x drought significantly improved model fit,
# so the more parsimonious burn-only model was retained
col_model_simple <- lm(
  perc_col_asin ~ burn,
  data = colonization_transformed
)

# Diagnostics for FINAL colonization model
pls205_diagnostics(col_model_simple)

# Test homogeneity of variance among fire-history treatments
car::leveneTest(
  perc_col_asin ~ burn,
  data = colonization_transformed,
  center = median
)

# ANOVA for final model
anova(col_model_simple)

# Estimated marginal means
em <- emmeans(col_model_simple, ~ burn)

# Dunnett-adjusted comparisons against High
dunnett_contrasts <- contrast(
  em,
  method = "dunnett",
  ref = "High"
)

dunnett_summary <- summary(dunnett_contrasts)
dunnett_summary

# Extract adjusted p-values and identify significant contrasts
dunnett_p <- setNames(
  dunnett_summary$p.value,
  gsub(" - ", "-", dunnett_summary$contrast)
)

# Generate figure letters from the Dunnett comparisons.
# Only comparisons against High are tested; comparisons among
# the other treatments are not interpreted as statistical tests.

treatments <- as.character(em@grid$burn)

# Start with a shared letter for all treatments
letters_dunnett <- setNames(
  rep("a", length(treatments)),
  treatments
)

# Assign a different letter to treatments significantly
# different from High
significant_vs_high <- dunnett_summary$contrast[
  dunnett_summary$p.value < 0.05
]

significant_vs_high <- sub(
  " - High$",
  "",
  significant_vs_high
)

letters_dunnett[significant_vs_high] <- "b"

# Treatments not significantly different from High retain "a".
# Give them "ab" so they share a letter with both High and
# treatments that differ significantly from High.
nonsignificant_vs_high <- setdiff(
  treatments,
  c("High", significant_vs_high)
)

letters_dunnett[nonsignificant_vs_high] <- "ab"

# Check the letters
letters_dunnett

# Merge letters with estimated marginal means
cld_tbl <- as.data.frame(em) %>%
  mutate(
    .group = unname(
      letters_dunnett[as.character(burn)]
    ),
    perc_bt = (sin(emmean))^2 * 100
  )

cld_tbl

```


```{r}
# Back-transform arcsine sqrt: 
# high
asin_mean <- 0.635
prop_est <- (sin(asin_mean)^2)
prop_est

# low (initial)
asin_mean2 <- 0.812
prop_est2 <- (sin(asin_mean2)^2)
prop_est2

# low (advanced)
asin_mean3 <- 0.804
prop_est3 <- (sin(asin_mean3)^2)
prop_est3

# suppressed
asin_mean4 <- 0.692
prop_est4 <- (sin(asin_mean4)^2)
prop_est4
```


## **5. Final Plot: Percent Colonization**
```{r final-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}

# Define colorblind-safe fill colors
burn_colors_cb <- c(
  "High"       = hcl(h = 15,  c = 75, l = 55),
  "Low (Initial)"  = hcl(h = 260, c = 60, l = 65),
  "Low (Advanced)"  = hcl(h = 75,  c = 65, l = 75),
  "Suppressed"      = hcl(h = 330, c = 50, l = 70)
)

# Set a uniform height for CLD letters across all groups
cld_tbl$label_y <- 75  # Set this to a constant height that clears all whiskers
y_axis_limit <- 80     # Set y-axis max just above the labels

# Final colonization plot
final_colonization_plot <- ggplot(
  colonization_filtered %>% mutate(perc_col = perc_col * 100),
  aes(x = burn, y = perc_col, fill = burn)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.9,
    width = 0.6,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    size = 2.5,
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.7,
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.6,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cld_tbl,
    aes(x = burn, y = label_y, label = .group),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = burn_colors_cb) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Percent Colonization (%)",
    limits = c(0, y_axis_limit),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Fire History") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
  axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.title.x = element_text(
  face = "bold",
  size = 14,
  margin = margin(t = 20)
),
  axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
  axis.text.x = element_text(
  angle = 45,
  hjust = 1,
  face = "bold",
  size = 14,
  margin = margin(t = 5)
),
  panel.border = element_rect(
    color = "black",
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 1
  ),
  legend.position = "none"
)

# Display the final aligned figure
final_colonization_plot

```

```{r}
# Save Colonization
ggsave(

)

ggsave(

)
```

#**Create Coefficient Table for Supplemental**
```{r}
library(broom)
library(flextable)

colonization_coef <- broom::tidy(col_model_simple) %>%
  mutate(
    term = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      "(Intercept)" = "(Intercept)",
      "burnLow (Initial)" = "Low (Initial)",
      "burnLow (Advanced)" = "Low (Advanced)",
      "burnSuppressed" = "Suppressed"
    ),
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Term = term,
    Estimate = sprintf("%.4f", estimate),
    `Std. Error` = sprintf("%.4f", std.error),
    `t value` = sprintf("%.4f", statistic),
    `p value` = ifelse(
      p.value < 0.001,
      "<0.001",
      sprintf("%.4f", p.value)
    ),
    sig = sig
  )

colonization_ft <- flextable(colonization_coef) %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") %>%
  autofit()

colonization_ft
```
